subject: robotics
intro: Robotics leads to the people who make machines move with purpose — building, programming and refining the arms, rovers and autonomous systems now working across industry.

roles.title: Robotics Technicians
roles.what: Build, install, test or maintain robotic equipment or related automated production systems — wiring, calibrating and debugging the work cells that engineers design.
roles.where: Configuration space and kinematics explain what a manipulator can reach; the robot control unit on PID and computed-torque plus perception sensors give you the calibration instincts the bench and cell work needs.

roles.title: Mechanical Engineers
roles.what: Perform engineering duties in planning and designing tools, engines, machines and other mechanically functioning equipment, and oversee installation, operation, maintenance and repair — the mechanical half of every robot.
roles.where: Rigid-body motions, Lagrangian dynamics with mass matrices and Coriolis terms, and trajectory generation are the modelling you will apply, while machine design — shafts, bearings, gears — is the hardware you will specify.

roles.title: Industrial Engineers
roles.what: Design, develop, test and evaluate integrated systems for managing industrial production processes — including the automated work cells, material flow and quality systems where robots earn their keep.
roles.where: Motion planning with RRT and PRM, obstacle avoidance and the mobile robot navigation topics feed the automated systems you integrate, with measurement and control basics grounding the commissioning work.

roles.title: Software Developers
roles.what: Research, design and develop computer and network software or specialised utility programs — increasingly including the perception, planning and learning code that turns robotic hardware into autonomous behaviour.
roles.where: Perception, estimation and SLAM — Kalman filtering, lidar and IMU fusion — plus the learning-based robotics frontier unit are exactly the software stacks this role writes and maintains.
